title: E6R-1: 3D-printed 6-DOF robotic arm
description: Open-source 6-degree-of-freedom robotic arm for teaching kinematics, trajectory planning and control. Includes 3D-printable STL parts, ESP32 + PCA9685 firmware, MATLAB/Simulink models (forward and inverse kinematics with the product-of-exponentials formulation, a digital twin and hardware-in-the-loop control), a MATLAB App Designer GUI and a URDF description.
